title: AI in technical writing: complete guide for 2026

title: What is DITA XML? Technical Writing & Content Management Guide
summary: The client’s Danish manufacturer switched to a SaaS DITA platform that proved slow, inflexible, and missing key features, forcing a move to a more robust DITA XML solution. summary: The Acrolinx article outlines common pitfalls writers encounter when creating DITA content, such as inconsistent topic structures, improper reuse, and neglecting metadata. title: A Beginner-Friendly Guide to Docs as Code & CI/CD Pipelines

title: What is Docs as Code? Guide to Modern Technical Documentation | Kong Inc.
summary: Kong’s article explains that Docs as Code treats documentation like software, using version control, plain‑text formats and CI/CD pipelines to keep docs in sync with code. title: AI-Powered Documentation Generation and Code-to-Docs Automation 2026 | Zylos Research
summary: In 2026 AI‑powered documentation generation has moved from experimental to production‑ready, with tools that analyze codebases, auto‑create docs, and stay synchronized via Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers used by 75% of developers.
